name: Free AI Credits
description: Static, read-only directory of currently-claimable free AI credit offers, each labeled with review status, evidence level, and sign-up need. Free AI Credits runs no interactive agent endpoint: supportedInterfaces points at the ordinary HTTPS document surface (HTML pages, per-page Markdown twins, llms.txt exports, RSS feed, and an OpenAPI-described static content API) through which agents read the catalog.

skills.name: List free AI credit offers
skills.description: Enumerate the currently active free AI credit offers with provider, category, amount, expiry, and trust labels via llms.txt or the Markdown page twins.
examples: Which providers currently offer free API credits?
List free coding-agent credits with no sign-up required.

skills.name: Read offer detail
skills.description: Fetch a single offer's full terms, claim steps, source URL, and last-checked date from its detail page or /offers/{slug}.md Markdown twin.
examples: What are the claim steps for the Tavily free tier?
When was the Zed student offer last checked?

skills.name: Interpret offer trust labels
skills.description: Explain the review_status, verification, signup, and last_checked labels that qualify every listed offer, as documented in llms.txt.
examples: What does verification=social_proof mean on an offer?
Does review_status=verified mean the curator claimed the offer?
